summary: Independent verification of HomeHero mobile responsiveness fix (HomeHero.tsx flex ratios + CTA flexDirection now isDesktop-only). All three defects resolved on mobile 390x844; tablet 768x1024 correctly renders stacked; desktop 1920x800 unchanged (two-column side-by-side layout preserved).

tablet_768x1024.layout: stacked column (left col top=522, right col top=952) - correct since isDesktop threshold is >=1024

desktop_1920x800.layout: two columns side by side (leftColTop=507 == rightColTop=507)
desktop_1920x800.dead_space_desktop_note: PRE-EXISTING flexbox stretch artifact: right column (Today Pulse + Momentum) is naturally taller than left column (title+CTAs+stats); left column's flex parent stretches to match tallest sibling, leaving space below stats. This is NOT introduced by the fix — the isDesktop path retains the same flex ratios (1.35/1.15 and 0.92) as before. Desktop layout unchanged per mandate.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix in HomeHero.tsx is minimal and surgical: (a) left column flex only when isDesktop, (b) right column flex only when isDesktop, (c) CTA row flexDirection = isDesktop ? 'row' : 'column'. No side-effects on desktop path.

Optional future enhancement: on desktop the left column has ~171px trailing space below stats grid because right column is taller. If product wants zero dead space at all breakpoints, consider justifyContent:'space-between' on left column or align-items:'flex-start' on the flex row — but this is a separate pre-existing behavior, not part of the current fix mandate.
